label.en: From memory: what is this site made of normally? (lining epithelium + wall/parenchyma)
label.zh: 凭记忆：该部位正常由什么构成？（被覆上皮 + 管壁/实质）

hint.en: Recall the lining epithelium — squamous (esophagus, cervix, head & neck mucosa) vs ductal/glandular (pancreas) — and the wall layers beneath it.
hint.zh: 回忆被覆上皮类型——鳞状上皮（食管、宫颈、头颈黏膜）vs 导管/腺上皮（胰腺）——以及其下的管壁结构。

label.en: From memory: which cancer type fits this site?
label.zh: 凭记忆：该部位对应哪种癌？

hint.en: Squamous-lined sites mostly give squamous cell carcinoma (esophagus, cervix, larynx); ductal/glandular sites give adenocarcinoma (pancreas).
hint.zh: 鳞状上皮部位多为鳞癌（食管、宫颈、喉）；导管/腺上皮部位为腺癌（胰腺）。

sources.title: PathologyOutlines · Adenocarcinoma of esophagus & GE junction

label.en: Confirm the tissue matches the stated site
label.zh: 确认切片组织与标注部位相符

label.en: Systematic low-power scan: flag dense, basophilic areas where normal architecture is lost — then zoom in to check
label.zh: 低倍系统扫查：标记深染密集、正常结构消失的可疑区——再放大确认

hint.en: Invasive carcinoma shows at low power as a cellular area effacing the lining/wall pattern — nests, sheets or infiltrative glands, often with desmoplastic stroma.
hint.zh: 浸润性癌在低倍下呈细胞密集区，破坏上皮/管壁结构——巢状、片状或浸润性腺体，常伴促纤维间质反应。

label.en: Confirm H&E staining and assess section quality (diagnostic FFPE)
label.zh: 确认 H&E 染色并评估制片质量（FFPE 诊断切片）

label.en: Weigh age, sex, smoking history and the site into a preliminary call
label.zh: 结合年龄、性别、吸烟史与部位做初步判断

hint.en: Smoking strongly associates with squamous cell carcinoma (e.g. larynx, esophagus) and is also a risk factor for pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma.
hint.zh: 吸烟与鳞癌强相关（如喉、食管），也是胰腺导管腺癌的危险因素之一。

label.en: Glandular differentiation: gland/duct-like structures, luminal or intracellular mucin → adenocarcinoma
label.zh: 腺体分化：腺样/导管样结构、腔内或胞内黏液 → 腺癌

hint.en: Adenocarcinoma shows glandular (ductal) differentiation, usually with luminal or intracellular mucin.
hint.zh: 腺癌呈腺样（导管样）分化，通常有腔内或胞内黏液。

sources.title: PathologyOutlines · Adenocarcinoma of esophagus & GE junction

label.en: Squamous differentiation: keratinization, keratin pearls, intercellular bridges → squamous cell carcinoma
label.zh: 鳞状分化：角化、角化珠、细胞间桥 → 鳞癌

hint.en: Squamous cell carcinoma shows squamous differentiation — keratinization with keratin pearls and intercellular bridges.
hint.zh: 鳞癌呈鳞状分化——角化形成角化珠，并可见细胞间桥。

label.en: Invasion: irregular nests/glands in desmoplastic stroma, beyond the normal lining
label.zh: 浸润：促纤维间质中的不规则巢/腺体，超出正常上皮范围

hint.en: Invasive carcinoma grows as irregular epithelial elements in desmoplastic stroma — e.g. PDAC shows intense stromal desmoplasia.
hint.zh: 浸润性癌在促纤维间质中呈不规则上皮成分生长——例如 PDAC 有显著的间质促纤维反应。

label.en: Cytology: crowded pleomorphic nuclei, mitoses, necrosis
label.zh: 细胞：密集异型核、核分裂、坏死

hint.en: Crowded, pleomorphic nuclei with mitotic figures and necrosis support malignancy over normal or reactive epithelium.
hint.zh: 密集的多形性核、核分裂象和坏死支持恶性，而非正常或反应性上皮。
